description:
Tasha and Wendell are getting married in the backyard, and Uncle Ricky keeps yelling stop the wedding over a dress tag, a lawn chair and a dog with a pillow. The wedding cake is leaning. Then Tasha finds out who is paying Ricky.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #wedding
tiktok_caption: pov: your uncle has one job at the wedding 💍 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #wedding

lines.text: Welcome to the wedding of Tasha and Wendell. I am the cake. I have one job. Stay standing.
Wendell. This is it. Sun is out, flowers are up, nobody is late.
I love you so much. Let us get married before anything happens.
Stop the wedding!
Uncle Ricky. Why.
Your tag is sticking out. The back of the dress. Big tag. Says dry clean only.
He is not wrong. I can read it from the table.
You stopped my wedding for a tag?
A bride should not be wearing instructions.
Got it. Tucked. Tag is gone. We are back.
Beat one. The tag. Everybody breathe. I am sweating frosting.
Okay. Wendell, do you take me...
Stop the wedding!
Ricky, buddy. Pal. Uncle of my future wife. What now?
Somebody is in my chair. Front row. Aisle seat. That is the Ricky seat.
That is a lawn chair you brought from home.
And it has my name on it. In marker. On the back.
It says Rick. He ran out of marker.
I ran out of chair, too. Cousin Dee is sitting in it eating a roll.
The dinner rolls are for after!
Rolls before vows. This family moves fast.
Dee, can you please move one seat over? Thank you. Love you, Dee.
From the top. Wendell, do you take me to be your wife, in good times and...
Stop the wedding!
Uncle Ricky, I swear on Grandma's potato salad.
The dog is eating the ring pillow.
Biscuit? Biscuit, no. Biscuit, that pillow is velvet.
The pillow is gone. The dog looks proud. The rings are on the grass.
See? Ricky saves the day. Again. You are welcome.
You also stopped it for a sneeze, a bird, and a cloud that looked like a boat.
That cloud looked exactly like a boat.
It did look like a boat. I will give him the boat.
That is six times, Ricky. Six. The pastor is checking his watch.
The pastor parked at a meter.
My bottom layer is leaning. I was built for one hour. This is hour two.
Nobody stops anything else. Ricky, I am looking at you. With love.
I would never. Unless there is a reason.
There is always a reason. Last spring he stopped a parade.
He did. For a balloon that looked like his landlord.
Why do you keep doing this? Do you not like Wendell?
I love Wendell. Wendell is a great guy. Wendell pays me twenty dollars a stop.
He pays you what?
Plot twist. And I was not even told, and I am in the middle of the table.
Okay. Okay. I can explain. I forgot to write my vows.
You had eight months!
I had eight months and one fantasy football league.
Every time I yell, he writes one line. On a napkin. Under the table.
The napkins match the flowers. At least the crime is pretty.
Show me the napkins. Right now.
Napkin one. Tasha, you are the tag I always want sticking out.
Oh no. That is kind of sweet.
Napkin two. I will always save you the best seat, even if it is Ricky's.
It is not available. But nice.
Napkin three. You are worth more than a velvet pillow to a dog.
Biscuit is crying. Or he has pillow in his throat. Hard to say.
Napkin four. When I look at you, every cloud looks like a boat.
Wendell. That was the best vow I have ever heard.
You are welcome. Hundred and twenty dollars, please. Cash or casserole.
Wait. If you paid him for six stops, why did he only stop it six times?
I paid for seven.
Oh no. There is one stop left. And everyone is looking at me.
I do. I do. Fast. Before he can...
I do! You may kiss... me. I kiss you. Done!
Stop the wedding!
What?
I want the first piece of cake.
Absolutely not. I stood here for two hours. I am cutting myself.
